LEFT JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id

    SELECT o.customer_id, o.order_id, COUNT(oi.product_id) AS product_count
    FROM Orders o
    INNER JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    WHERE o.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM credit_card_customers)

)

FROM order_product_counts
GROUP BY customer_id
